headline: S&P Global (SPGI) Stock Looks Slightly Overvalued After Its 18% Fall
summary: S&P Global stock has fallen 18.1% year to date, yet the current checks suggest it is neither a clear bargain nor obviously mispriced. The intrinsic value estimate from the Excess Returns model points to roughly fair value, while market multiples lean expensive. The share price decline of 18.1% year to date may already reflect some of the concern around the business, even as investors reassess what a reasonable valuation looks like.
